title: Epizootic
summary: EPIZOOT'IC, adjective [Gr. animal.] In geology, an epithet given to such mountains as contain animal remains in their natural or in a petrified state, or the impressions of animal substances. Epizooti

inlines.v: EPIZOOT'IC, adjective [Gr. animal.] In geology, an epithet given to such mountains as contain animal remains in their natural or in a petrified state, or the impressions of animal substances. Epizootic mountains are of secondary formation.
